text:
The Nifty 50 closed at 25,030.35, up 2.01% on the day, while Bank Nifty rose 2.27% to 59,086. The rally was broad‑based: 216 stocks advanced against 277 declines in the Nifty 500, giving a breadth score of 67.3 (rated “HEALTHY”). Advances outnumbered declines in the 20‑day, 50‑day and 200‑day moving‑average zones, indicating the market is holding above key trend lines.  

Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) were net buyers, adding ₹13,749.82 crore, whereas Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) sold ₹5,968.70 crore, extending an eight‑day buying streak for FIIs and a six‑day selling streak for DIIs. Financial Services, Consumption, Infrastructure, Realty and Auto led the sector quadrants, while IT, Bank and Pharma showed weakening. Options data show a put‑call ratio (PCR) of 1.65 for Nifty, a max‑pain level at 24,700 and a call wall at 26,000, suggesting downside bias but with support near 24,000 (put wall).  

Watch the 24,602 S1, 24,816 P and 25,244 R1 pivot points on Nifty 50 and the 57,909 S1, 58,498 P and 59,674 R1 on Bank Nifty. Key headlines to monitor include Airtel’s post‑results dip, Tata Steel’s slide, and any RBI rate or money‑market moves that could affect the USD‑INR (currently 93.89). A break below the 24,000 put wall could test lower support, while a move above the 26,000 call wall may open the next upside leg.
